breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on all edges and also periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified the conflict, specified the implementation of only the Dirichlet conditions, and explicitly added the instruction 'Do not apply periodic boundary conditions or identify endpoints', perfectly resolving the inconsistency.
